projects.title: JAHIDUL.COM.BD
projects.summary: A modern personal portfolio website built to showcase my video editing work, wedding films, commercial advertisements, and creative storytelling through a clean, responsive, and fast web experience.
projects.overview: This portfolio represents my creative journey as a professional video editor and visual storyteller. Built with React, Vite, and React Router, the website features a clean user interface, smooth animations, responsive layouts, and a JSON-driven content structure. Every section—including profile information, portfolio projects, skills, education, contact details, and social links—is managed from a single JSON file, making future updates simple without modifying component code.
features: JSON-driven content system for easy updates without changing code
Professional portfolio showcasing commercial ads, wedding films, and short-form content
Fully responsive design optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile
Smooth animations and modern scrolling experience
Project gallery with individual video previews powered by Google Drive
Direct contact options via WhatsApp, Email, and SMS
Clean and minimal UI focused on visual storytelling
Easy-to-maintain architecture ready for future backend integration

projects.title: LIKHON.COM.BD
projects.summary: The agency's own portfolio and business website — a fast, animated, fully responsive React site with a JSON-driven content system so any text can be edited without touching code.
projects.overview: This is the site you're looking at right now. Built with React, Vite, and React Router across 4 pages (Home, Projects, Project Details, Start a Project). Every piece of content — nav, hero copy, team, tech stack, project list, testimonials, contact details — is pulled from a single JSON file through a small API-client function, so it can be swapped for a real backend later without touching any component code.
features: JSON-driven content — nav, text, team, and projects are all editable from one file
API-client pattern ready to swap for a real backend with no component changes
Fully responsive with an animated slide-in mobile menu
Scroll-reveal animations and count-up stat numbers
One-click contact via WhatsApp, Email, or SMS — no backend required
Category-filterable project showcase with individual case-study pages

aboutme.name: LIKHON SORKAR
aboutme.title: Full Stack Web Developer
aboutme.shortDescription: Full Stack Web Developer crafting fast, scalable web apps with Python, Django & React — from the first line of code to production deployment.
longDescription: I'm a Full Stack Web Developer specializing in Python, Django, and React. I design and build modern, responsive, scalable, and high-performance web applications from the ground up.

Beyond development, I handle the entire deployment pipeline — hosting and deploying frontend applications on Cloudflare Pages, and guiding clients through domain configuration, SSL setup, and ongoing project maintenance — so nothing is left for you to figure out alone. I provide complete technical support and I'm ready to help whenever you need it.

Whether you already have a Django or React project that needs to be managed, maintained, optimized, or upgraded, or you're looking to migrate an existing website onto Python & Django, I make the transition smooth, secure, and built to scale.
